takes.overview: Jabroni Beaters are 7-1 with 99.1% playoff odds and the top projected strength (143.6), and nobody in the chase pack is close: PuttinOnTheFoil (6-2, 88.8%, 138.6) and Matt's Monstrous Team (6-2, 78.2%, 135.7) trail, while Torts Illustrated is 4-4 yet still at 66.1% with 136.7 strength. Defense and goaltending both rank #1 in quality, and forwards (#4 quality, #3 rest of season) are the one soft spot in an otherwise dominant build. Around the league, Victor Hedman (McDISHHH) sat out with illness per Rotowire via ESPN, Elias Pettersson (Angie's Bear Balls) is out with an upper-body issue and will be re-evaluated after the road trip per Thomas Drance of The Athletic, and Brad Marchand is back for Torts, so check news before reading too much into any of it.
takes.matchup: This week against Mike's Magnificent Team is 64.3 to 60.1 in my favor so far, projecting 149.5 to 138.3 for a 69.5% win chance, with starts nearly even (39 to 40). Fri Nov 27 and Sat Nov 28 are the swing days, so that is where Mike's can still make this interesting. Next week's date with McDISHHH is a near coin flip at 52.6% (148.4 to 146.5). The playoff-week projection has Jabroni Beaters at 315.6, comfortably ahead of PuttinOnTheFoil (282.0), Timmy's Tenacious Team (278.1) and Matt's Monstrous Team (275.2).
takes.roster: The trade market favors selling forward luck: Alex Tuch (26% shooting, L15 +34% vs model), Jack Quinn (19%, +49%) and Frank Nazar (24%, +122%) carry the SELL HIGH tags. Mike's, Torts and Angie's Bear Balls all need forwards and all have surplus D, so they are the natural buyers and a D-for-F framework fits. Moritz Seider (2% shooting) and Jakob Chychrun (4%) are the buy-low tags and look due for positive regression, so they are holds rather than sells. Injuries to check news on: Jimmy Snuggerud is listed OUT with no return date, Pavel Dorofeyev is on IR with return date unknown, and Connor Bedard is on IR with a note of Nov 23 pointing to a return around Mar 23.
